walkthroughs.title: Better Man Project Agent Configuration
walkthroughs.description: Learn how to configure AI agents for pastoral coaching and spiritual growth

steps.title: Understand the Agent Schema
steps.description:
Agent configurations follow a standard JSON schema with identity, model parameters, data access, tools, and metadata.

[Open README.md](command:vscode.open?%5B%7B%22path%22%3A%22README.md%22%7D%5D)

media.markdown:
## Core Schema Sections

- **Identity**: `id`, `name`, `description`
- **Model params**: `model`, `temperature`, `top_p`, `max_tokens`
- **Data access**: `entities` array for database tables/views/RPCs
- **Tools**: `tools` and `allowed_tools` arrays
- **Instructions**: `system_prompt` and `instructions`
- **Metadata**: `visible`, `tags`, `metadata`

steps.title: Choose the Right Model
steps.description:
Different agent types require different models and temperature settings.

[View Model Guidelines](command:markdown.showPreview?%5B%22README.md%22%5D)

media.markdown:
## Model Selection Patterns

**Coach/Pastoral Agents**
- Model: `gpt-5.1-mini`
- Temperature: `0.4-0.7`
- Use for: Empathetic, conversational responses

**Builder/Reasoning Agents**
- Model: `gpt-5.1`
- Temperature: `0.1-0.3`
- Use for: Structured, precise outputs

**Orchestrator Agents**
- Model: `gpt-5.1-mini`
- Temperature: `0.3`
- Use for: Classification and routing

steps.title: Study the Prayer Coach Example
steps.description:
The `prayer_coach` agent is a complete reference implementation showing all schema fields.

[Jump to Prayer Coach](command:workbench.action.findInFiles?%7B%22query%22%3A%22prayer_coach%22%2C%22filesToInclude%22%3A%22README.md%22%7D)

media.markdown:
## Key Features

- Accesses `JournalEntry`, `DailyProgress`, `Devotional`, `BibleStudy`
- Calls RPCs to fetch devotionals and journal entries
- Structured output: Heart Check / Guidance / Sample Prayer / Scripture Anchor
- Temperature: `0.5` for empathetic responses

steps.title: Craft Effective System Prompts
steps.description: System prompts should reference the unified style guide, define role, specify output format, and include security rules.

media.markdown:
## System Prompt Structure

1. Reference unified style guide
2. Define role identity and purpose
3. Specify interaction approach (empathy, directness)
4. Outline output format with named sections
5. Add security/runtime rules
6. End with: "Use internal reasoning silently; output only the final [result]"

steps.title: Define Tools and Scopes
steps.description: Tools enable agents to call RPCs or HTTP webhooks. Always specify scopes for access control.

media.markdown:
## Tool Pattern

```json
{
  "name": "rpc.fetch_today_devotional",
  "type": "rpc",
  "description": "Supabase RPC: get today's devotional",
  "endpoint": "/rpc/fetch_today_devotional",
  "scopes": ["read:devotional"]
}
```

HTTP tools add `url` and `method` fields.

media.markdown:
## Creation Checklist

- [ ] Pick model and temperature
- [ ] Enumerate entities needed
- [ ] Declare tools with scopes
- [ ] Set allowed_tools subset
- [ ] Write system_prompt with output format
- [ ] Add tags for filtering

steps.title: Map to Base44 Platform

media.markdown:
## Key Mappings

- `id` → `agent_id`
- `name` → `title`
- `system_prompt` → `developer_instructions`
- `entities` → `allowed_entities`
- `tools` → `integrations`

See section 4 in README.md for examples.

walkthroughs.title: Advanced Agent Configuration

steps.title: Configure Entity Access
steps.description: The `entities` array controls which database tables, views, and RPCs an agent can access.

media.markdown:
## Common Entities

**User Data**
- `JournalEntry` - User journal entries
- `DailyProgress` - Daily check-ins and metrics
- `PrayerRequest` - Prayer requests and intentions

**Content**
- `Devotional` - Daily devotional content
- `BibleStudy` - Study materials and guides
- `Scripture` - Bible verses and references

**Relationships**
- `Accountability` - Accountability partner data
- `Community` - Group and community info

steps.title: Implement Scope-Based Security
steps.description: Use scopes to control tool access and enforce least-privilege principles.

media.markdown:
## Scope Patterns

**Read Scopes**
- `read:devotional` - View devotional content
- `read:journals` - Access user journals
- `read:prayer` - Read prayer requests

**Write Scopes**
- `write:prayer_intents` - Create prayer records
- `write:progress` - Update user progress
- `write:notifications` - Send notifications

**Admin Scopes**
- `admin:users` - Manage user accounts
- `admin:content` - Manage content

steps.title: Design Multi-Agent Workflows
steps.description: Use orchestrator agents to coordinate specialist agents for complex user needs.

media.markdown:
## Orchestrator Pattern

The `workflow_meta_agent` analyzes user input and:
1. Classifies the primary need
2. Recommends 1-3 specialist agents
3. Provides prompts for each agent
4. Suggests call order

**Example Flow**
User: "I'm struggling with anger"
→ Orchestrator recommends: Prayer Coach + Leadership Mentor
→ Prayer Coach: Guides immediate prayer response
→ Leadership Mentor: Addresses root causes and habits

steps.title: Test and Validate Configurations
steps.description: Use JSON Schema validation to catch configuration errors early.

media.markdown:
## Validation Features

This workspace includes:
- **JSON Schema validation** for `*agent*.json` files
- **Required fields**: `id`, `name`, `description`, `model`
- **Type checking** for all standard fields
- **Auto-complete** in VS Code

Create a file matching `*agent*.json` to see validation in action!
